top_topics.title: India-EFTA Trade and Economic Partnership Agreement (TEPA)
top_topics.summary: India signed the historical TEPA with European Free Trade Association (EFTA) countries (Iceland, Liechtenstein, Norway, Switzerland), securing a target of $100 billion investment in India over 15 years.
top_topics.upsc_relevance: GS Paper II (Bilateral Groupings and Agreements) & GS Paper III (Effects of Liberalization on the Economy)

top_topics.title: Recommendations on 'One Nation, One Election'
top_topics.summary: The High-Level Committee on Simultaneous Elections submitted recommendations to synchronize elections for Lok Sabha, State Legislative Assemblies, and local bodies in a phased manner.
top_topics.upsc_relevance: GS Paper II (Electoral Reforms, Indian Constitution, Federalism)

top_topics.title: Milestones in India's Gaganyaan Mission Preparation
top_topics.summary: ISRO successfully completed key human-rating tests for the L110 Vikas Engine and designated astronaut candidates, preparing for the uncrewed G1 test flight.
top_topics.upsc_relevance: GS Paper III (Awareness in the fields of Space, Indigenization of Technology)

top_topics.title: Environmental Review of the Great Nicobar Island Project
top_topics.summary: Ongoing scrutiny surrounding the Rs 72,000-crore mega-infrastructure plan in Great Nicobar, balancing strategic maritime dominance with biodiversity conservation and tribal rights (Shompen & Nicobarese).
top_topics.upsc_relevance: GS Paper III (Conservation, Environmental Impact Assessment) & GS Paper I (Tribal Issues)

top_topics.title: RBI Guidelines on Climate-Related Financial Risks for Banks
top_topics.summary: The Reserve Bank of India released a draft disclosure framework requiring regulated entities to report governance, strategy, and metrics related to climate-related financial risks.
top_topics.upsc_relevance: GS Paper III (Indian Economy, Banking Sector, Sustainable Development)
